summary: The old harness cannot exercise the new per-context XInclude error handler. Other possible gaps, including a preexisting DOM processing blocker, remain unresolved by the supplied evidence.

claims.necessity_reason: The target creates an XInclude context and processes XInclude nodes. The after source supports a structured handler on that context, but the complete old entry never installs one. Its global generic handler does not configure this context capability.

before.requirement: Process XInclude errors using the available error route; a per-context structured handler is not supported.
before.reason: Before the change, XInclude errors pass NULL as the structured handler, and the context has no handler fields.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before context has no per-context handler state.

after.requirement: Permit a configured structured handler to receive XInclude errors from the target's XInclude context.
after.reason: The setter stores the handler and callback data, and XInclude errors use them. The old harness creates and uses a context without calling the setter.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: An XInclude element with an invalid parse value supplies a finite error condition.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Initialization installs only a global generic error handler.

claims.comparison_reason: The per-context callback capability is added on the after side. The fixed old harness has no call that configures it.

claims.necessity_reason: The after memory-error helper no longer sets the context error code, while the harness checks that code after an injected allocation failure. Whether a finite input reaches an XInclude allocation failure after the old harness's document-node guard is unresolved.

before.requirement: Record XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY in the XInclude context when XInclude processing runs out of memory.
before.reason: The before helper sets errNo, but the packet does not establish that the harness's document-node argument reaches processing.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The harness's document-node argument must pass this guard before XInclude processing.
A failed base allocation is one possible XInclude memory-error call after the guard.

after.requirement: Record XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY in the XInclude context when XInclude processing runs out of memory, so the existing harness check remains true.
after.reason: The after helper passes NULL for the optional error structure and does not set ctxt->errNo. An accepted harness call reaching this failure would violate the check, but reachability is unresolved.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: With a NULL error argument, xmlRaiseMemoryError updates the global error but no context error structure.
The document-node guard determines whether the harness reaches the changed processing path.
A failed base allocation calls the changed memory-error helper.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The input controls the allocation-failure limit.
A mismatch in the existing allocation-failure check aborts the harness.

claims.comparison_reason: The context error-code assignment was removed, but a concrete old-harness witness depends on whether its parsed document node passes the unchanged guard.
missing_information: The doc field of a valid document returned through parser.c::xmlDoRead.
The document construction path, including tree.c::xmlNewDoc and any relevant SAX2.c document initializer.

claims.necessity_reason: Both versions reject a node whose doc field is NULL. The harness passes the parsed document node, but the supplied parser entry delegates its construction.

before.requirement: Reach DOM XInclude processing for a valid parsed document containing an include.
before.reason: Whether the returned document node passes node->doc != NULL is not supplied.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The parser entry delegates construction of the returned document to xmlDoRead.

after.requirement: Reach DOM XInclude processing for a valid parsed document containing an include.
after.reason: The same guard remains, and the returned document node's doc field is still unestablished.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The after parser entry also delegates document construction to xmlDoRead.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The separate reader route does not establish whether the explicit DOM call succeeds.

claims.comparison_reason: The possible blocker is the same document-node argument and unchanged guard on both sides; its outcome is unknown.
missing_information: The value of doc->doc for valid documents returned by parser.c::xmlDoRead.
Whether parser.c::xmlDoRead performs equivalent DOM XInclude processing under these options.

claims.necessity_reason: Both versions reject local XPointer inclusions in streaming mode. The explicit context leaves streaming mode unset, while the reader may provide an equivalent route; its setup and build configuration are missing.

before.requirement: Reject a local XPointer inclusion with XML_XINCLUDE_XPTR_FAILED when streaming mode is enabled.
before.reason: The restriction is present conditionally, but the reader activation and relevant build defaults are unresolved.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The reader conditionally enables streaming mode and processes XInclude nodes.

after.requirement: Reject a local XPointer inclusion with XML_XINCLUDE_XPTR_FAILED when streaming mode is enabled.
after.reason: The restriction remains, but it is unknown whether the old harness activates the reader route under the supplied build.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The after reader has the same conditional streaming route.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The harness forces XML_PARSE_XINCLUDE into its options.
The harness also passes those options to a reader and reads it.

claims.comparison_reason: The same source restriction and old-harness routes exist on both sides. The possible reader route prevents a grounded finding that streaming rejection is unreachable.
missing_information: Both versions of xmlreader.c::xmlTextReaderSetup, especially how XML_PARSE_XINCLUDE sets reader->xinclude.
Both versions of xmlreader.c::xmlNewTextReader and its initial state.
configure.ac defaults for LIBXML_READER_ENABLED, LIBXML_XINCLUDE_ENABLED, and LIBXML_XPTR_ENABLED under the supplied build recipe.
Both versions of parser.c::xmlDoRead and the document construction path through tree.c::xmlNewDoc or SAX2.c::xmlSAX2StartDocument.
Both versions of xmlreader.c::xmlTextReaderSetup and xmlreader.c::xmlNewTextReader.
configure.ac defaults governing reader, XInclude, and XPointer support in the supplied build.
